# Test fixtures

`legacy-desktop.sqlite` and `legacy-desktop.expected.json` were generated by the
now-removed `packages/storage-sqlite` code (the database through its `initDatabase`
and public API, the expected JSON from its `exportData().data`). They are frozen:
`tests/desktop-legacy-reader.test.js` checks that `legacySqliteReader` still reads
this database into exactly that JSON. Do not regenerate them.
